findings.highlight: my sight and spirit are dyed jet black.
findings.evidenceJa: 視界と知覚が、黒一色に染め上げられた。
findings.governingReading: The burst dyes Shirou's field of vision and perception entirely black as he covers Illya.

findings.highlight: It's so dark, even though I can see clearly. I must have fallen into a black sun.
findings.evidenceJa: こんなにハッキリ見えているのに暗いってコトは、黒い太陽でも落ちてきたのか。
findings.governingReading: Seeing clear blackness makes him wonder whether a black sun has fallen/come down.
findings.explanation: A black sun falling upon the scene becomes Shirou falling into it.

findings.highlight: The complete sensory loss is more revolting than any pain.
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みより、触覚がない喪失感が気色悪い。
findings.governingReading: Absence of tactile sensation feels more revolting than pain.
findings.explanation: Loss of touch becomes loss of every sense.

findings.evidenceJa: じゅっ、と音をたててキレイさっぱり消え去った。
findings.governingReading: Everything beyond left shoulder disappears cleanly with a brief sizzling sound.
findings.explanation: The sizzling instant of the left-side disappearance vanishes.

findings.governingReading: After the burst, the black Shadow melts away without trace, perhaps having exhausted its power.
findings.explanation: The Shadow disappearing becomes Shirou disappearing.
